title: Research exact local P104 I-G/2 tail correction
body:
## Result

This adds an exact finite rowwise `I-G/2` tail correction to the pinned P104 low-rank `G/2` channel. At the cut after the 4,058-event channel prefix, all 104 `X` source registers are full-frame and each of the 104 `Y` targets is in its rank-eight endpoint frame. For each target, the word promotes to the full frame, adds the 48 nonzero entries of `(2I-G)/2`, then restores the endpoint frame.

The registered package proves the exact arbitrary-input identity over all 280 formal columns and checks 208 native rank-one frame-change recipes. It records 4,992 scalar additions, four mutation controls, and deterministic witness/recipe hashes.

## Local cost and limits

The augmented local paid profile is `{1:1282, 2:58, 3:86, 4:104, 5:48, 6:24, 7:8, 8:8}`, rank mass 2,576. Under the same exact local relaxation, its ceiling is lower than the frozen uncorrected channel by the rational interval in `RESULT.json`; the relaxed moment at `a=1/99` is greater than one.

This is a partial local construction, not a complete supplier or a new `kappa`. Global owner/host scheduling and copied-information delivery for the source reads remain unproved, and the word is not integrated with the chronological delivery schedule in #1940. The channel and native realization in #1972/#1991 remain frozen and unchanged.

## Provenance and reproduction

- The package records exact source hashes and the 2026-10-14 upstream/overlap checkpoint in `TASK.json`.

On Python 3.12, from repository root:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-tail-side-correction-seed749717 --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-tail-side-correction-seed749717
```

Both commands passed after rebasing this branch onto current main. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used for verifier implementation, exact screening, and package preparation; disclosure is included in `TASK.json`.
